data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic with strong evidence of real customer projects and specific interactions. The single negative review is detailed and credible, indicating a potential issue with stain/finish longevity and post-sale support. The high 5-star rating is plausible for a quality contractor but the sample is moderate (68 reviews). No evidence of widespread fake reviews.
fake_signals: Some reviews have generic, slightly promotional language
High concentration of 5-star reviews with few lower ratings
authentic_signals: Multiple specific details (crew names: Justin, Zachery, Paul, Philip, Beau; project types: covered porches, pool decks)
One detailed negative review with specific timeline and complaint
Mentions of custom work and problem-solving
data.discrepancy_explanation: Insufficient rating data from other platforms to detect a discrepancy. Google rating is high but based on a moderate number of reviews.

reviews.text: I did a rent to own porch and it was delivered in January 2022. I had problems with the stain looking bad and called them within 2 weeks of receiving it. They sent a guy out and he did a little stain on the floor and that was all. I called them back to complain and a gallon of stain showed up at my house. Which is rude and to expect me to stain the porch ?? I gave up on the company and well today I've been paying on it for 44 months of the 48 month contract and the stain looks awful.  Looks to be 10 plus years old. Not such good company service. They won't do anything and I understand I should have pushed harder then and now I have a nice porch that needs to be stained when it should have been done right the first time. It was not high traffic here either , myself and my mom I cared for. I need to stand up for myself better than I have in life and its sad the stain didnt last out the contract .
reviews.author: Tracy Zurn

reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of working with Hershy Decks, and I couldn't be happier with the entire experience. From start to finish, their team demonstrated professionalism, expertise, and a genuine commitment to quality. They listened carefully to my ideas and provided valuable suggestions to enhance the design. The craftsmanship was exceptional, and the materials used were top-notch, resulting in a beautiful, durable deck that perfectly fits my outdoor space. The project was completed on time and within budget, and the crew—Beau, Phillip, and Jose—was respectful and tidy throughout the process. Hershy Decks even traveled from Itasca all the way to southern Oklahoma to ensure everything was perfect. I highly recommend Hershy Decks to anyone looking for reliable, high-quality deck construction. They truly exceeded my expectations!
reviews.author: Matthew Villarreal

reviews.text: Hershey  Decks built my deck for me.it is beautiful! I was surprised at how good it was built.it will last for many years.all of the people are very professional and very nice! Thank You Hershey Decks!

reviews.text: Hershey and Sons built our covered porches / decks. We are very pleased with our purchase and had a great experience with the company from the order to the delivery. Justin and Zachery delivered and installed all three for us. They did a great job!

reviews.text: This group of gentlemen were simply amazing from first contact to delivery of my pool deck. They answered every question I had, provided additional guidance on a couple things and production with delivery was right on time. I can not even begin to say enough wonderful things about the craftsmanship of the deck. I am so pleased with Mr. Paul, Mr. Philip and Mr. Beau for all of their assistance in making sure I had exactly what I expected for my family. Our deck is beautiful, solid and will last many years to come.

reviews.text: I originally contacted Angus Portable Buildings through their website and from that point on I was working with Hershy Decks. They did a fantastic job from start to finish. reviews.text: We bought a covered deck off the lot. When it arrived, it wouldn't fit. We had measured wrong. The guys said no problem.  They took some measurements and ask us what size and color of stain would we like. He said we'll build you one custom.  2 weeks later they delivered it and it fit like a glove. The construction is outstanding, good quality! The delivery guy was awesome! He had it installed in no time. We highly recommend this product and this company. The price was affordable and the quality of material and construction is great!

reviews.text: We purchased decks for the front and back of our cabin. Working with Irene on the design and purchase was amazing. We had great communication with her and Andrew at the shop. reviews.text: Hershey&Sons made two porches for us to replace our 19 year old porches. I was first impressed with the examples. I expected them to be very expensive from what I saw. The fellow came out and made measurements and listened to our requirements then sent bids in a few days. I couldn’t pass up the opportunity to get new porches for such a reasonable bid even though I was wondering  whether the construction and quality would measure up to the examples. We were not disappointed in the least. Both porches delivered and installed in one morning. They were exactly like the examples and the custom fits were perfect. I highly recommend Hershey&Sons in every way.
reviews.author: Roy Humble

reviews.text: Justin was amazing! Very professional, and very knowledgeable. Great communication. Did everything in a timely manner.

reviews.text: What an incredible build. I had had so many problems with Midlothian and Waxahachie contractors that I really was not expecting to find people who were honest and delivered what they promised, when they promised.  The price was absolutely fair , the workmanship fantastic, they were spot on for the day and time they promised. I can't say enough.
reviews.author: D S

reviews.text:
Wow! Talk about amazing craftsmanship! I had a nephew that had a porch built by Hershy & Sons a few years back and was very impressed with their work. Well today they delivered our amazing 20 x 16 Covered Porch with ramp to our new home church in Alvord,Texas.  We are not only excited but impressed by the quality,craftsmanship,fabrication and set up. The two gentleman that came to deliver were impressive and answered any questions we had and explained every part of the process of setting up and attaching the roof top to our existing home. I highly recommend Hershy & Sons for your deck or porch needs! God bless and Merry Christmas to all.

Pastor Lane Farr
House of Acts Church
Alvord,Tx
